prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, early 20s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, blunt bob jet-black hair — full body polished rhodonite fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING rich rose-pink rhodonite surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID black manganese vein striations flowing through every section, with tiny inlaid gemstones set along the joints, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Pose: turned away from the camera, looking back over her shoulder, one hand brushing her hip, the other hanging down — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Cracks: the rhodonite body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her right forearm, and one chipped-off piece at her left calf, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw pale pink-grey stone with a rough chalky surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the rhodonite is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals in red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved rhodonite right down to the shoes.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, carved from the same rhodonite with a high polish.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: wet-look black gradient eyeshadow with a chrome highlight on the lids, a graphic black liner, sleek lashes, high-shine black vinyl lips like polished glass, a cool matte contour. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved rhodonite.

Background: a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a tall olive tree, bright midday light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — carved material everywhere from the collarbones to the ankles. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
